purpose: Record the exact SCENIC+ execution environment used by the V69 lane, with every tool verified by running it rather than by reading a tool list.

published_recipe.note: Digest supplied by the coordinator, who reports it matches that repository's own validation/dockerfile_sha256.txt.

jepa_repository_recipe.verification: Recomputed from the file in worktree D:/jepa_wt_v69_scenicplus_20261001 and matched.
jepa_repository_recipe.note: A DIFFERENT recipe from the published one. It is the recipe that adds create_cisTarget_databases, cbust, liftOver and bigWigAverageOverBed, which Section 4 of the V69 freeze depends on.

what_is_verified: Every tool this lane uses was executed inside that image and returned its version.
The JEPA repository recipe's sha256 was recomputed and matches.
PROVENANCE_CAVEAT__DO_NOT_OVERSTATE.what_is_NOT_verified: That image 520053641b60... was BUILT FROM either recipe.
PROVENANCE_CAVEAT__DO_NOT_OVERSTATE.why_not: Docker does not retain a binding between an image and the Dockerfile text that produced it. Layer history is not proof of that binding.
PROVENANCE_CAVEAT__DO_NOT_OVERSTATE.wording_rule: No receipt in this lane may say 'image built from recipe X'. The image id and the recipe digests are recorded as separate facts.
PROVENANCE_CAVEAT__DO_NOT_OVERSTATE.which_recipe_the_running_image_RESEMBLES: The running image contains /opt/create_cisTarget_databases, /usr/local/bin/cbust, /usr/local/bin/liftOver, /usr/local/bin/bigWigAverageOverBed and /opt/mallet, which are features of the JEPA repository recipe. This is consistent with that recipe and is NOT proof of it.

tool_smoke_tests_executed_inside_the_run.method: Each tool was invoked and its own output captured. The container README's tool list was not treated as evidence.

liftOver.evidence: liftOver - Move annotations from one assembly to another

PATH_CAVEAT_FOUND_BY_THIS_LANE.observation: `command -v bedtools` (and macs2, samtools, meme, mallet) under `docker run ... bash -lc` reports ABSENT.
PATH_CAVEAT_FOUND_BY_THIS_LANE.cause: The micromamba base environment is not on a login shell's PATH.
PATH_CAVEAT_FOUND_BY_THIS_LANE.consequence_if_unnoticed: A naive PATH probe yields a FALSE ABSENT for five tools that are in fact present and working, which could have been written into a receipt as a missing-dependency blocker.
PATH_CAVEAT_FOUND_BY_THIS_LANE.rule_adopted: Every conda-provided tool is invoked through `micromamba run -n base`; /usr/local/bin and /opt/mallet/bin tools are invoked by absolute path.

published_validation_receipts_to_cross_r.note: Both the published manifest and the regenerated one are to be recorded. Only the regenerated one has been produced here.

environment_manifest.expected_warning: A pkg_resources DeprecationWarning is emitted on import. The runtime deliberately pins setuptools<81; this is expected and not a defect.

abandoned_alternative.what: A conda environment built directly in WSL by scripts/v69/build_scenicplus_env_wsl_v1.sh.
abandoned_alternative.outcome: ABANDONED in favour of the validated container.
abandoned_alternative.why_it_failed: SCENIC+ 1.0a2 hard-pins datrie==0.8.2, whose C source does not compile against the modern GCC in this WSL image (incompatible-pointer-type errors in libdatrie's AlphaMap). pycisTopic, pycistarget, pyscenic and scenicplus itself all built successfully; only that one transitive pin blocked the install.
abandoned_alternative.script_retained: Yes, as a record of what was attempted and why it failed. It is NOT the execution environment and must not be used as one.
abandoned_alternative.note: The container already solves this: it installs datrie=0.8.2 through conda with a compatible toolchain.

execution_pattern.command: docker run --rm --shm-size=16g -v D:/jepa_wt_v69_scenicplus_20261001:/workspace -v D:/jepa_v5_outputs_20260925/v69_scenicplus:/data -w /workspace scenicplus:1.0a2 micromamba run -n base <command>
execution_pattern.mounts: Only this lane's own worktree and its own output directory.
execution_pattern.reason: Another lane owns those. Stage-4 vocabulary was read read-only from outside the container and is not mounted into it.
